response.sql:
SELECT
  MediaType.Name AS MediaTypeName,
  AVG(Track.UnitPrice) AS AverageUnitPrice,
  AVG(1.0 * Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
WHERE Track.Bytes >= 10323804
GROUP BY MediaType.Name;

assumptions.assumption: The threshold is inclusive: tracks with Track.Bytes equal to 10323804 are kept. AVG ignores NULL inputs, so missing values are excluded and an average with no non-NULL inputs is NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: If “larger than the threshold” means strictly greater than 10323804 bytes, use this predicate instead.
